title: Welcome to Daily Bread
author: Daily Bread editor
excerpt: Why this journal exists, and how faith can inform our response to the world.
body: Daily Bread is a place for Scripture, reflection, Christian fellowship and thoughtful engagement with the world around us.
This journal is a space for personal writing and contributions from clergy and other Christian voices. Articles express their authors' views; they are not automatically the teaching of any church.
Our hope is to seek truth with humility, comfort those who suffer and turn conviction into peaceful service.
